purpose: Teach: まわし/近づき/ウサギ/改札/加熱/旨い/ヤバイ/思いつく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、コマまわし、教えてくれたな、子供の頃。
lines.en: Your grandfather taught me to spin tops when I was a boy, you know.
lines.style: Soft, distant voice like reaching back through time. Gentle nostalgia, not sadness. Pause after the opening phrase. Slow, deliberate pace—the cadence of memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。台風、関東に近づきつつあるって、ニュースで言ってたわね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. They were saying on the news the typhoon is getting closer to the Kanto region.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact observation with a thread of concern underneath. Not dwelling on worry, just noticing. Steady breath. The tone of someone who reports facts gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、お祖父ちゃんち、庭で、ウサギ、飼っていたわね、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember? Your grandfather kept rabbits in the garden back then.
lines.style: Gentle questioning, almost conversational—checking if the memory is shared. A slight lift on the question. Warm, inviting her to remember with him. Not urgent.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 駅の改札、最近、ICカードばかりで、楽になったわね。
lines.en: You know, they've made things so much easier at the station lately with those IC card gates.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation with quiet appreciation. Short beat of thought before speaking. The tone of someone noticing small modern conveniences without fuss. Slightly warm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おでん、加熱しなおすと、味、染み込むんだよな。
lines.en: Oden tastes so much better when you warm it up again. The flavor really soaks in.
lines.style: Warm, settled certainty—a life truth delivered simply. Slight emphasis on 'soaks in' like he's savoring the rightness of it. Steady, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が作ってくれたお菓子、本当に旨いものだったわね、あなた。
lines.en: The sweets your grandchild made for us—they were really delicious, weren't they, dear.
lines.style: Tender warmth with genuine delight. Soft attack on the opening word. The gentle pride of someone speaking of a gift received with care. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年金、ヤバイ状況だな、最近のニュース、心配だ。
lines.en: The pension situation lately is worrying. The news keeps saying such difficult things.
lines.style: Weight of real concern beneath a composed surface. Not alarming or angry, but honest worry. A slight heaviness on 'pension situation.' Measured, thoughtful delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いい解決策、ふと、思いつくのよ、寝る前にね、私。
lines.en: I often think of good solutions just before bed, you know. They come to me suddenly.
lines.style: Quiet, almost dreamy observation. Soft attack, gentle trailing-off at the end like she's half-talking to herself. Peaceful, not rushed. The voice of someone reflecting on a small personal truth.
